2399.body:
"LIFE OF LUXURY" offers a top prize of $1 million and ten prize levels in all. The prize money leans no one direction in particular. Games shaped like this offer both kinds of prizes without favoring either. This design never changes, while every other number on this page does.

Each day without a top prize claim on "LIFE OF LUXURY", the remaining top prizes are spread across fewer unsold tickets. The number of tickets printed is fixed.
